error: ValueError: Positive total needs positive squared sum
cause: Some positive representable weights are so small that direct w*w underflows to zero. The positive total is then incompatible with the raw squared-weight diagnostic accumulator.
corrective_action: Normalize weights by running maximum only inside the diagnostic squared-norm accumulator; mathematically scale-invariant neff. Do not change filtering weights, h, output normalization or reference measurements.
